description: This is an abstract base class for integration tests related to the 'thing search persistence' component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up and manages a MongoDB test environment, initializes persistence components, and provides utility methods for testing, such as counting and finding things using queries.

classes.name: AbstractThingSearchPersistenceITBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for integration testing persistence layer for thing search in Eclipse Ditto, including MongoDB interactions and actor system management.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes the MongoDB resource and the query builder factory before any test runs.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up actor system, persistence components, and test collections before each test.

methods.name: provideReadPersistence
methods.description: Creates and initializes the MongoDB-based persistence component.

methods.name: provideWritePersistence
methods.description: Creates the write streaming persistence component.

methods.name: provideClientWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and configures the MongoDB client wrapper.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up collections and shuts down actor system after each test.

methods.name: dropCollections
methods.description: Drops specified MongoDB collections with backoff in case of failure.

methods.name: dropCollectionWithBackoff
methods.description: Attempts to drop a MongoDB collection repeatedly with delay until successful or max attempts reached.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB resource and closes the MongoDB client after all tests.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the count of items matching a query, optionally filtered by subject IDs.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns all items matching a query, optionally filtered by subject IDs.

methods.name: runBlockingWithReturn
methods.description: Runs a reactive source and blocks until the result is available, returning the final value.

methods.name: getMaterializer
methods.description: Provides the Akka materializer from the actor system.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Collects all elements from a Source into a list, blocking until complete.

methods.name: backoff
methods.description: Implements a brief delay for backoff retries when dropping collections.
